claims.text: The 15-node Domain Expansion & 8-Arm Ego ontology (5 JJK domain variants, Black Flash, 8 Ego Arms, Meta-Compiler) forms a closed 225-pair mechanical graph governed by 10 formal rules, 8 modifiers, and 8 resource pools.

Restriction-for-Immunity trades (Toji 0-CE Heavenly Restriction, PoE Chaos Inoculation) transfer their exact failure mode across substrates: deleting one vulnerability layer grants hard immunity against that layer's sensors/attacks while leaving zero backup buffer against orthogonal/inanimate channels (PRED-DEE-001 confirmed via Stuxnet air-gap breach).

Closed-domain barriers (high interior guaranteed-hit, brittle exterior shell) are structurally isomorphic to in-distribution ML models and perimeter firewalls, sharing the identical failure mode of out-of-distribution / exterior-substrate shatter (PRED-DEE-002 confirmed).

Governor-Removal Overdrive (Guts Berserker Armor) transfers its failure mode (Load-Coupled Leak requiring external governor re-imposition) across human physiology (rhabdomyolysis), silicon thermal-throttle removal, and total-war mobilization (PRED-DEE-003 confirmed).

Axiomatic distance defenses (Gojo Infinity) are bypassed by coordinate-manifold cuts (Yami Dimension Slash / World-Cutting Slash), isomorphic to cryptographic ciphers bypassed by physical side-channel substrate attacks (PRED-DEE-004 confirmed).

Unlimited Void information overload maps operationally to LLM attention saturation and human cognitive lockup, while cosmological mapping to the Bekenstein bound remains an untested STRUCTURAL_ANALOGY (PRED-DEE-005 untested).

Soul Eater O(N^2) multiplicative cross-link compounding amplifies detection across N compiled domains but predicts precision-collapse noise at high N unless pruned by strict residual gates (PRED-DEE-006 untested at N>100).
